title: Radar chart
description: Compares one or a few items over several indicators with different scales (skills, product reviews, flavor profiles). Hover a polygon to highlight it and its nearest indicator; the arrow keys move between series and indicators, Esc clears; click a legend item to hide a series.

examples.title: Comparing products
examples.description: Three series get a legend automatically; onHover reports the series and the indicator closest to the pointer.

examples.title: Circular grid
examples.description: shape="circle" draws round rings, levels sets their number and dots={false} hides the vertices; opacity strengthens the fills.

translationResources.title: Radar chart
translationResources.description: Compares one or a few items over several indicators with different scales (skills, product reviews, flavor profiles). Hover a polygon to highlight it and its nearest indicator; the arrow keys move between series and indicators, Esc clears; click a legend item to hide a series.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: One series over six indicators with max: 10; the tooltip lists every value and bolds the indicator under the pointer.

compare.title: Comparing products
compare.description: Three series get a legend automatically; onHover reports the series and the indicator closest to the pointer.

circle.title: Circular grid
circle.description: shape="circle" draws round rings, levels sets their number and dots={false} hides the vertices; opacity strengthens the fills.

players.title: Player comparison
players.description: Two football players over six attributes; min and max on the indicators zoom every axis on the 30-99 range where the ratings differ, and each series sets its own color.

capabilities.title: Product capabilities
capabilities.description: Analyst ratings of a product, a competitor and the market average. hidden makes the visibility controlled: the checkboxes and the legend (onToggle) share the same state.

nutrition.title: Nutrition facts of breakfasts
nutrition.description: Three breakfasts on a circular grid (shape="circle", levels={5}), each axis in percent of the daily value. renderTooltip uses the event's indicator to list the amount of the hovered nutrient in every meal.

live-monitor.title: Live service monitor
live-monitor.description: The current load is redrawn every second (setInterval, cleared when the switch is off or on unmount) over the last hour's baseline, and turns red above the alert threshold. Only the busiest metric and the alert state are announced, not every tick.

review-360.title: 360° review
review-360.description: A Select picks the person whose ratings are drawn over the team average; keeping the person as the second series makes the polygon animate in place. The line below names their largest strength and gap compared to the team.

sales-targets.title: Sales targets with mixed units
sales-targets.description: Every indicator has its own min and max, so revenue, deal count, win rate and NPS share one chart; the target is an unfilled outline. onClick and renderTooltip read the event's indicator to show the actual value, the target and the attainment of a KPI.

RadarChartProps.indicators: Axes of the chart, clockwise from 12 o'clock

RadarIndicator.name: Name of the axis
RadarIndicator.max: Value at the rim; the largest value of the series when omitted

RadarSeries.name: Name shown in the legend and the tooltip
RadarSeries.color: Color of the polygon; taken from the palette when omitted

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Press near a vertex to read the score of a skill; format writes the scores out of 10.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.description: Two series on a circular grid; hidden and onToggle keep the legend state in the app.

compare.title: Compare two series
compare.description: Two models over five indicators; the legend hides or shows a series.

circle.title: Circular grid
circle.description: shape circle draws round grid rings, levels sets how many.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
